column1: # Bold7 French word substitution (Substitutions.parse): typed form, TAB, replacement, SmartCase.
# OS 7 ships none in the 9900 loader: this list is our own, written by eye (D). Source:
# typed form is itself a word, French or English, at least as frequent as its replacement (the
# user writes in both languages; deliberate abbreviations such as stp, bcp, rdv are kept as
# they are), then writes autotext_fr.tsv, copied here.
